subject: Request to pause pilot timer and extend sandbox access while procurement completes
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena@stadiahealth.com>, procurement@stadiahealth.com
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Request to pause pilot timer and extend sandbox access while procurement completes

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the quick demo this week. We heard back from our billing team that your PO routing is still in progress; understood this sometimes happens when procurement needs a few documents (SOW/W-9).

We don't want your engineering team to lose momentum. Two quick options we can offer while your procurement queue clears:
- Pause the pilot timer for up to 14 days (we freeze the countdown on your sandbox), or
- Provide a 10-day credit top-up so you can keep running load tests while the legal/finance loop finishes.

If you can share a rough ETA from procurement (even an expected week), we’ll lock the right option in. If procurement prefers a specific path (e.g., they need DocuSign SOW before we issue credits), let us know and we’ll route to the right internal partner.

If it helps, I can loop in our billing ops to send the W-9 and an SOW draft for signature — that usually speeds things up.

Next step: would you like us to pause the timer or credit the account?

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com | (415) 555-0132

Attachment: Stadia_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW draft, version for procurement)
From: Elena Morris <elena@stadiahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@stadiahealth.com
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request to pause pilot timer and extend sandbox access while procurement completes

Karthik —

Appreciate the proactive note. Procurement is moving the PO through but they flagged two items that need to be on file before they can issue a PO: an executed SOW and an up-to-date W-9 from your vendor. Our internal cycle put us around the week of July 12 for final approval, earliest.

If Redwood can commit to either a 10-day credit or a pause while procurement finishes, that would be ideal. The engineering team is mid-integration and we risk losing momentum if the sandbox cuts off.

I’ve looped procurement@stadiahealth.com on this thread. They asked us to request the W-9 and the SOW as a one-pager (DocuSign preferred).

Thanks — I’ll confirm the exact delivery date once procurement returns from their vendor review meeting on Monday.

— Elena
Director of Product, Stadia Health
elena@stadiahealth.com

Attachment: Stadia_PO_Notes.txt (procurement checklist)
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena@stadiahealth.com>, procurement@stadiahealth.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Jul 2027 14:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request to pause pilot timer and extend sandbox access while procurement completes

On Fri, Jul 2, 2027 Elena Morris <elena@stadiahealth.com> wrote:
> Karthik —
> 
> Appreciate the proactive note. Procurement is moving the PO through but they flagged two items that need to be on file before they can issue a PO: an executed SOW and an up-to-date W-9 from your vendor. Our internal cycle put us around the week of July 12 for final approval, earliest.
> 
> If Redwood can commit to either a 10-day credit or a pause while procurement finishes, that would be ideal. The engineering team is mid-integration and we risk losing momentum if the sandbox cuts off.

Hi Elena & procurement team — thanks for the clarity. We can absolutely accommodate this. To summarize what we can do immediately: 

- We will pause the pilot timer for 14 calendar days (we’ll freeze the sandbox session and extend access).
- Alternatively, if you prefer token credits, we can issue a 10-day equivalent credit to keep the environment live.

Action items from Redwood:
1) I’ve attached an editable W-9 (Procurement_W-9.xlsx) and our SOW draft (Stadia_SOW_v1.pdf) for your legal to review.
2) If procurement prefers DocuSign for the SOW, tell us the signer name and we’ll send the envelope today.
3) Please route any PO or finalized paperwork to billing@redwood.com so our finance team can expedite invoicing once the PO hits.

Elena — which of the two options would you prefer? We can implement the pause immediately (no paperwork required) and follow up with the signed SOW and W-9 to close formally.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com | (415) 555-0148

Attachment: Procurement_W-9.xlsx (editable W-9), Stadia_SOW_v1.pdf (re-attached)
From: procurement@stadiahealth.com
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Elena Morris <elena@stadiahealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 17:06:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request to pause pilot timer and extend sandbox access while procurement completes

Camila / Karthik —

Thanks for the options and the materials. We reviewed the SOW and have attached a completed W-9 (Stadia_W-9.pdf) on our side; please confirm receipt. Procurement expects to issue an internal approval the week of July 12 but asked if Redwood could apply a 10-calendar-day extension to the pilot as a courtesy while we finalize the PO — that should be sufficient for our engineering team to finish the integration tests.

Also, please provide a DocuSign link for the SOW and confirm that billing@redwood.com will accept the PO when ready. Our AP team prefers net30 terms; if you have standard paperwork for those terms, send it along.

We’ll watch for the DocuSign envelope and the billing address for the PO.

Procurement
Stadia Health
procurement@stadiahealth.com

Attachment: Stadia_W-9.pdf (completed W-9 from Stadia Health)
